name: 30238 · Jonesboro, GA
findings: ZIP 30238 (Jonesboro) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30238 (Jonesboro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30238 (Jonesboro) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
